name: context-atlas
description: Evidence-backed project memory for onboarding, architectural context, history, and safer AI-assisted changes.

interface.shortDescription: Understand project history before changing code
interface.longDescription: Build an evidence-backed mental model of a project, trace how and why it evolved, retrieve task-specific context, and inspect durable reviewed memory while state changes remain in the human-operated CLI.
defaultPrompt: Explain this project from first principles and cite the evidence behind each important claim.
Build a context pack for my next coding task and identify affected components, decisions, and risks.
Trace how this subsystem evolved and separate current facts from superseded or inferred claims.
